add.baseUrlHint: The remote cognia-server address. Use its public URL (cloudflared or reverse proxy) to reach it across networks.

discover.empty: No Cognia hosts are advertising on this network.
discover.emptyHint: The host needs its companion server running with mDNS on (its Settings → Companion).
discover.matchStale: This invitation points at {claimed}, but the host is advertising at {live}.
discover.notAdvertising: This host isn't advertising here — pairing will use the address in the invitation.
discover.title: On this network

add.errHttp: Pairing failed (HTTP {status}). Generate a fresh pair token on the host and try again.
add.errMissing: Paste a pair payload or a pair JWT.
add.errNetwork: Could not reach the host. Check the URL and that its companion server is running.
add.errPayload: That doesn't look like a pair payload or JWT.

loopback.absent: No host answered on this computer's loopback port.
loopback.absentHint: A browser can only reach a host over http://127.0.0.1. For a host on another machine, paste its invitation above.
loopback.blocked: A host answered at {url} but has not allowed this browser.
loopback.blockedHint: On that machine, add {origin} under Settings → Companion → Browser access.
loopback.foundHint: Run `cognia-server pair` on that machine and paste what it prints above.
loopback.title: On this computer

add.payloadHint: On the host run `cognia-server pair` and paste what it prints. A full payload fills in the URL for you.
add.payloadPlaceholder: Paste the cgnp2 payload from `cognia-server pair`, or a raw pair JWT
add.seededFrom: Seeded from {url}. The invitation still has to be pasted.

description: Drive a remote Cognia host — its terminal, files, and git — from this desktop. Files and git read with pairing; writes need the host to grant this device control.

list.activeBanner: Driving {label} — new terminals, file, and git operations target this host.
list.capabilitiesUnknown: Capabilities unknown — connect once to ask this host
list.capabilityNote: Reads (open files, git status, diff, log) work once paired. Writing files, commits, and pushes need the host to grant this device control in its allow-list.
list.emptyBody: Pair a remote Cognia server to drive its terminal, files, and git from here. Add one on the Add host tab.
list.featureManifestUnknown: Operation-level feature contract unavailable — writes stay disabled until the host reports one
list.featurePermissionNote: Advertised operations still require their command permission; management writes require remote-control, and high-risk writes require an Owner admin lease.

title: Remote hosts
